digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup and operation lifecycle
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture deployment/startup config once at service initialization rather than re-reading it per operation/request
Inbound bearer tokens and OAuth material must remain transient request-scoped context and never enter startup snapshots, operation snapshots, logs, caches, or serialization
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) before accepting a job/webhook, with no fallback to alternative principals on failure
Static configuration changes (env/file mutations) only take effect after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned credential refresh remains unchanged
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable telemetry without altering operation results, while security-critical auth remains fail-closed
